hints.title: Knapsack Reduction
hints.text: Buying stock i costs present[i] and yields profit max(0, future[i] - present[i]). Each stock can be bought at most once.

hints.title: Budget Bounded Space
hints.text: Maintain dp[b], the maximum profit achievable with a total spending of b up to budget.

hints.title: Descending Transition
hints.text: Iterate budget b downwards from budget to present[i] to prevent reusing the same stock multiple times.

hints.title: 0-1 Knapsack Stock Trading Implementation

complexity.notes: Classic 0-1 knapsack DP running over budget capacity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all 2^n stock combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D array of size budget + 1 stores maximum achievable profits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate filters out non-positive profit stocks and updates knapsack states backwards.
